setup.zh: 外门的院子里晒着柴，井边排着水桶。一个穿灰袍的年轻人拿着账本，一个一个点名。
setup.en: Firewood dries in the outer court; buckets stand in a row by the well. A young man in a grey robe goes down the names with a ledger.

recap.zh: 外门，周衡发下第一份功课：配齐八味灵草，炼一炉丹。
recap.en: In the outer court Zhou Heng set the first chore: pair the eight herbs, make a furnace of pills.

text.zh: 新来的，都一样：挑水、劈柴、背功法。做完了才有灵石，做不完——
text.en: New ones, all the same: carry water, split wood, learn the manual. Done, you get spirit stones. Not done —

text.zh: 没有灵石就买不了丹，买不了丹就修得慢，修得慢三年后就得下山。懂了？
text.en: no stones, no pills; no pills, slow cultivation; slow cultivation, down the mountain in three years. Understood?

text.zh: 今日功课：配齐八味灵草，炼一炉丹。
text.en: Today's chore: pair the eight herbs and make a furnace of pills.

exits.means: sets out, goes back down to the river, or asks to move on

refuse.zh: 丹还没炼成。周衡的账本上，你那一行还空着。
refuse.en: The pills aren't made. Your line in Zhou Heng's ledger is still empty.
